blocks.x: The other time, they told me about y'all. She told me that, I come last week, she says, you got somebody, one of the musicians wants to see you. I said, want to see me? I said, oh, I said, alright, I know what that's for. I said, take the record of the old time. She said, yeah. She said, do you? I said, yeah. They said, yeah. I said, yeah, that's true. I said, alright. I said, I'll be here. That's how I come. That's how I come. I said, when you first come drive. I said, Horace, somebody wants you. I said, I know where that is. I said, one of the musicians. I said, okay. I told you to come on in, so.
You were telling us out at Millenberg they were playing the Carolina Moon Keeps Shining, I believe you said.
